title: Client build 70707: 133 data rows changed (Oct 30)
claim: Client build 1.60.1.70707 appeared on Oct 30 with 133 changed data rows versus 70685, while realms are closed and without development notes.
detail: Daybreak's diff lists renamed Mage talents (Improved Fireball -> Accelerant, Elemental Precision -> Precision), Revenge and Balance spell text changes, an Adventurer's Tent change, the 70685 Camping spell removed again, a pet Stamina tooltip change, and new level-60 items and tier sets. ForeverChanges dates it Oct 30 and calls it unconfirmed. Class values from the same push are in the Oct 30 class notes. Nothing can be checked in game until launch.

title: Adventurer's Tent becomes a 15 min tent, 15 min cooldown
claim: Datamined build 70707: Adventurer's Tent changes from a rested tent with a 1-hour cooldown to a miniature tent lasting 15 minutes on a 15-minute cooldown; unconfirmed by Blizzard.
detail: ForeverChanges lists the old and new text; Daybreak shows the Adventurer's Tent spell text changed and its spell category removed, and the Camping spell added in 70685 removed. It is not clear whether this item is the camp's Camp Tent feature (rested top-up to 5% of a level, once per hour) or a separate cosmetic/shop tent; check in game at launch before changing the camp model.

title: Druid Oct 30 talents: Berserk gone, Shifting Power 8 s
claim: Druid (Oct 30 hotfix data): Berserk removed, Lacerate and Bloom added, Shifting Power cooldown 16 to 8 s, Primal Bite damage 26/38/59 to 42/62/77, Genesis and Naturalist 2-10%.
detail: Wowhead's Oct 30 class-tuning article; wowforever.be says the hotfixes are live in data but no development notes confirm them. Also: Leader of the Pack applies to all crits, Swiftmend needs your own Regrowth/Rejuvenation, Naturalist also shortens Wild Growth's cast (3 s base). Forum players say Shifting Power moved to a deeper tier (around level 40) and shapeshift mana costs feel high for Feral; not confirmed.

title: Paladin Oct 30 talents: Holy Shield 100 mana
claim: Paladin (Oct 30 hotfix data): Holy Shield costs 100 mana (was 150) and deals 32% less damage; Improved Seals 5 ranks up to 15%; Conviction 6% at 3 ranks; Vindication no longer adds attack power.
detail: From Wowhead's Oct 30 class-tuning article (wowforever.be: live in data, not in dev notes). Also: new talents Boundless Light, Oath of Light, Shieldsworn, Stoicism, Turn Evil, Unsealed Wrath, Swift Judgement; Reverence 2 ranks (30% regen at max); Spiritual Focus 5 ranks up to 70%; Iron Creed 3 ranks; Champion of the Light 5 ranks, Hammer of Wrath cast 1 s shorter; Two-Handed Weapon Specialization physical damage only. Righteous Fury at level 10 is in note 20261024-righteous-fury-level-10.

title: Mage Oct 30: Ice Lance 300% vs frozen, Arcane Blast
claim: Mage (Oct 30 hotfix data): Ice Lance does 300% damage to frozen targets (was 200%) on an 8 s cooldown; Arcane Blast stacks add 100% mana cost (was 175%) and last 18 s; Arcane Focus removed.
detail: From Wowhead's Oct 30 class-tuning article (wowforever.be: live in data, not in dev notes). Also: Critical Mass 6% at 3 ranks (was 10% at 5), Incineration 10% crit at 5 ranks for Fire Blast/Ice Lance/Arcane Blast/Scorch, Ice Barrier +15% Frost damage, Winter's Chill makes the next Cone of Cold +20%, Arcane Resilience row 1 (armor = 75% of Intellect at rank 3), Missile Barrage row 2, Improved Fire Blast row 3. Improved Fireball is now Accelerant and Elemental Precision is now Precision (all crit). Follows the 70685 Mage hotfix in 20261029-mage-talent-hotfix-70685.

title: Warrior Revenge scales with attack power (build 70707)
claim: Warrior Revenge now adds 22.5% of attack power at every rank (rank 6: 138-168 plus 22.5% AP); datamined Oct 30, not in development notes.
detail: ForeverChanges reads the 70707 tooltip as 138-168 + 22.5% AP for rank 6; Wowhead/wowforever.be summarise it as about 25% of attack power at all ranks. Helps tanking-stance leveling Warriors as gear improves.

title: Oct 30 data: Pathfinding row 3, SW:Death backlash 30%
claim: Oct 30 hotfix data: Hunter Pathfinding moves to Beast Mastery row 3 (was row 2), Priest Shadow Word: Death backlash 30% (was 10%), Warlock Improved Drains returns more mana from Drain Mana.
detail: From Wowhead's Oct 30 class-tuning article (wowforever.be: live in data, not in dev notes). Pathfinding (run speed) now needs at least 10 points in Beast Mastery. Priest also gets a new Holy talent, Holy Binding. Build 70707 also changes the pet tooltip to 'every 1 Stamina adds 2 Health' (was 7.5), relevant to bug report 20261024-hunter-pet-stamina-no-hp.

title: Launch: joining a group asks before changing layer
claim: At launch, joining a group no longer moves you to another layer at once: a prompt lets you choose when to move, and forced world refreshes are far rarer than in early beta.
detail: Blizzard engineers on the WoW: Forever Podcast episode 6 (Oct 29): being moved just for receiving an invite was a bug and is fixed; the end-of-beta state is what launch will be; the eviction graph was near flat from Oct 2. Aggrend: each zone or small zone group is a layer, so zone borders and refresh windows remain ('not a perfect contiguous world'). Earlier statement (Clay Stone, Oct 23): groups stay together on boats/zeppelins and entering or leaving capitals. Replaces the 'group joins still swap layers' part of the Oct 26 note.

title: Riding: 100 g at level 40, 1,000 g at 60
claim: First mount at level 40: Apprentice Riding costs 100 gold for 60% speed; at 60 Journeyman Riding costs 1,000 gold and epic mounts 200 gold each for 100%; Honored with your home faction takes 10% off both.
detail: Method (Oct 21, cites Wowhead spell/quest pages and beta testing) says the 100 g training includes one basic mount and extra colors cost 20 g; Warcraft Tavern's riding guide lists the 20 g mount separately, so budget 100-120 g at 40. The Bartering Legacy perk takes up to 10% more off mounts (not training). Other races' mounts need Exalted with that race. Paladins and Warlocks get a free mount from a level 40 class quest (Warlock: Strahad Farsan in Ratchet); their level 60 epic quests cost hundreds of gold in reagents. Skyborne buy galestriders from Genn Fairweather on Zephras Isle. Store mounts still need the Riding skill.

title: Major patches about every 4 months (17 weeks)
claim: Blizzard targets a major WoW Forever patch about every four months (17 weeks, three a year) around new raid tiers, with some content below level 60 unlocking between patches.
detail: Principal game designer Kris Zierhut in IGN's launch interview, reported by PC Gamer (Oct 28) and Wowhead (Oct 29). Season of Discovery's 8-week cadence 'felt way, way, way too fast'. Some sub-60 content unlocks 'two or three months in or one month into' a cycle. Raids open Dec 9 (n:20261009-beta-launch-dates), so the next major patch would land around spring 2027. Same interview: dual spec at launch (n:20261012-dual-spec-level-40-maybe-30).

title: Recently Played With list and stable zone cohorts
claim: Forever places players into zone layers as consistent cohorts so you keep meeting the same people, and a Recently Played With list collects players you grouped, traded or camped with so you can regroup.
detail: From Blizzard's IGN launch interview (Kris Zierhut, Tim Jones), as reported by a DynaSage/IGN India repost and quoted in a US forum thread: with 5,000 players in Elwynn, people are placed into instances of the zone in groups; people you group with, trade with, cast spells on or meet at campsites are listed for easy regrouping. Blizzard calls these pro-social systems (with 10, 20 and 40-player raids) its main answer to griefing. Pairs with the launch layering notes n:20261031-group-join-layer-prompt and n:20261029-layering-zone-groups-launch.

title: Oceanic day/night cycle: Blizzard weighing 3 options
claim: Blizzard is weighing three fixes for Oceanic players stuck in NA night: Australian time on OCE layers, a shifting cycle of about 20-23 hours, or keeping NA time; it asked for feedback and has not decided.
detail: Raised on the WoW: Forever Podcast episode 6 (Oct 29) and reported by Wowhead (Oct 30); the US forum feedback thread passed 600 replies. Holiday event start and end times also land at awkward OCE hours. Bug report forever-bugs #424 (OCE layers run on North American world time) is still open. No change is announced for launch.

title: Whetstones now stack with poisons and imbues
claim: In Forever, whetstones can be used alongside poisons and weapon effects such as totem imbues, so Blacksmithing whetstones are worth more to sell and to use while leveling.
detail: From Mein-MMO's beginner guide (Karsten Scholz, Oct 21), not yet confirmed by Blizzard or a second source. Same guide: pair a gathering profession with its crafting one or take two gathering professions for gold; avoid two crafting professions; park a bank/AH alt in a capital; save for the level 40 mount (n:20261031-riding-costs-40-60).

title: Whetstones now stack with poisons and imbues
claim: In Forever, sharpening stones and whetstones work alongside Rogue poisons and Shaman weapon imbues, so Blacksmithing stones sell to and help more classes while leveling.
detail: Blizzard's class previews (Oct 10) say poisons stack with sharpening stones and Shaman imbues stack with stones; Mein-MMO's beginner guide (Oct 21) calls out the higher value of whetstones for Blacksmiths. Same guide: pair a gathering profession with its crafting one or take two gathering professions for gold; avoid two crafting professions; park a bank/AH alt in a capital; save for the level 40 mount (n:20261031-riding-costs-40-60). Class detail: n:20261010-rogue-leveling-changes, n:20261010-shaman-imbue-totem-qol.

title: Minor Speed boots 4%; new 8% Speed formula at 280
claim: Oct 31 hotfix data: Enchant Boots - Minor Speed drops from 8% to 4% run speed, and a new tradeable Formula: Enchant Boots - Speed (280 Enchanting) gives the 8%.
detail: wowforevertalents.com lists both changes in the Oct 31 hotfix layer (formula item 289560, uncommon, requires Enchanting 280). playfulls.com's Oct 31 game-data diff independently lists the new Enchant Boots - Speed enchant and its Formula (item level 50, Uncommon) but does not show the Minor Speed value. Not in Blizzard's notes and not checkable until launch. For leveling: a Minor Speed enchant is worth half as much as in Classic; the full 8% needs a high-level enchanter, so expect the new formula and its enchant to be in demand and pricey early. Night Elf Quickness still stacks with boot speed (20261019-ne-quickness-stacks-speed).

title: Druid: Primal Bite ranks 2-3 move to levels 50 and 60
claim: Druid (Oct 31 hotfix data): Primal Bite rank 2 is learned at level 50 (was 36) and rank 3 at 60 (was 48); Ferocious Bite rank 1 is learned at level 24.
detail: From playfulls.com's Oct 31 game-data diff (Primal Bite replaced the Berserk talent in the Oct 30 Feral rework, see 20261031-druid-oct30-talents). The same diff lists Lacerate rank 2 at level 34 (150 rage, +10% weapon damage per application) and Wild Growth with a 3 s cast. wowforevertalents.com confirms the rank changes but shows no learn levels. Several entries on the playfulls page are garbled, so treat the learn levels as unconfirmed until trainers can be checked at launch.

title: Suspected gold trading triggers an economy hold
claim: Accounts suspected of real-money gold trading get a Temporary Economy Hold that blocks trade, mail, guild bank and Auction House use; Blizzard says it leaves no strike unless RMT is proven.
detail: Announced by community manager Kaivax on the WoW forums (reported by PC Gamer, Oct 14). It applies to both sellers and receivers of illicit gold. Blizzard warns of false positives while the system is tuned. The hold has no stated duration. Practical effect: avoid large unexplained gold transfers from strangers, which can trip it; Blizzard separately says gold buyers risk permanent account loss (20261031-no-gdkp-no-token).

title: No GDKP raids and no WoW Token in Forever
claim: WoW Forever does not allow GDKP raids and has no WoW Token; Blizzard says it will punish gold buyers very aggressively, up to permanent account loss.
detail: Kaivax and senior game designer Josh Greenfield on the beta-launch stream (GameLuster, Sep 20): GDKP is banned because it displaces guild loot systems, not mainly because of RMT; no penalty tier for joining one was given. Blizzard will watch the economy and can adjust drop and consumable availability. COGconnected (Oct 19) adds: no WoW Token (BlizzCon interview), no plans for paid boosts, and grouping only within the same faction and ruleset. Plan raid loot as guild loot (DKP, loot council), not gold bids.

title: Pre-launch maintenance Nov 4, 18:00-23:00 UTC
claim: Pre-launch maintenance on Nov 4 runs from 18:00 to 23:00 UTC (10 a.m. to 3 p.m. PST), so the game is unavailable that afternoon until the 23:00 UTC launch.
detail: A Battle.net launcher notice quoted on the US forum (topic 2397379, Oct 31) reads: scheduled maintenance begins Wednesday, November 4th, 10:00 AM PST, and the service is expected back at approximately 3:00 PM PST; the game is unavailable for play meanwhile. Daylight saving ends Nov 1, so PST is UTC-8: 18:00-23:00 UTC, 1-6 p.m. EST. The end matches the official launch time (Nov 4, 23:00 UTC; Nov 5 in EU and Asia local time). Character creation and name reservation will likely be closed during the window. No Blizzard post repeats the window yet.

title: Ruleset bug: new characters listed under RP-PvP
claim: Players report that characters created on the Normal or RP ruleset show up under Roleplay PvP in the character list, so check each new character's ruleset before launch.
detail: US forum topic 2397371 'Check your ruleset!' (Oct 31): the poster deleted and recreated characters on Normal and RP and each time they were listed under Roleplay PvP; at least six other players reproduced it, and one says the characters appear under every ruleset, which points to a list display bug rather than a wrong realm. Players guess it came with the extra servers added this week; another says RP-PvP was missing from the main list on the first day of character creation. No Blizzard reply yet. What matters for play is whether the character is really on a PvP ruleset (open world PvP): check the PvP state in game at launch, and re-check the ruleset list before playing.

title: Paladin: Salvation and Blessing of Light removed
claim: Oct 31 hotfix data removes the Paladin spells Salvation, Mass Salvation, Blessing of Light, Greater Blessing of Light and Revoke, plus the talents One-Handed Weapon Specialization and Instrument of Law.
detail: Listed as removed in wowforevertalents.com's Oct 31 hotfix layer over build 70685 (118 Paladin changes). playfulls.com's Oct 31 diff and Wowhead's Oct 30 tuning article (see 20261031-paladin-oct30-talents) do not mention the removals, so this rests on one datamine. If it holds, groups lose the Paladin threat-reduction blessing (DPS in leveling dungeons must manage threat themselves) and Holy loses the Blessing of Light healing bonus. The same layer adds Voice of Truth at level 20 (6 s silence and interrupt immunity). Check the trainer and spellbook at launch.

title: Druid: Ferocious Bite damage cut about 30%
claim: Oct 31 hotfix data cuts Druid Ferocious Bite rank 4 by about 30%: 173-223 to 122-162 damage at 1 combo point and 685-735 to 490-530 at 5.
detail: From wowforevertalents.com's Oct 31 hotfix layer (43 Druid changes): extra energy now converts at 2 per point instead of 2.5, and Ferocious Bite goes from 4 to 5 ranks, so a new top rank may restore some late damage. The new Predatory Discipline talent stops Bite from converting extra energy. Primal Bite gains damage (20261031-druid-oct30-talents) but its ranks 2-3 move to levels 50 and 60 (20261031-druid-feral-learn-levels). For Feral leveling, mid-level finishers hit noticeably softer. Druid forum threads (2397303, 2397188) are angry about Feral and Restoration; no Blizzard reply. Check trainer values at launch.

title: Night Watchman's Torch: free light from Duskwood
claim: At night in Duskwood, a dead Night Watch Guard starts a one-step quest whose reward, the Night Watchman's Torch, gives 5 minutes of light on a 30 s cooldown.
detail: Method's guide (Oct 7) and an Icy Veins article: Forever's lighting makes Duskwood, Tirisfal Glades, Silverpine Forest and Stranglethorn Vale dark at night. The guard's body appears only at night (wait until about 20:00 game time) and moves between spots in the south and west of the zone, often near Raven Hill. Both factions can get it (Horde via the Grom'gol zeppelin), the quest can be shared, and you carry only one torch (come back if you delete it). Combat, water or entering a major city puts it out. Useful when questing in the dark zones at night.
